name: @openlance/aios-analytics-intelligence
description: Phase 5 Stage 5 Analytics Intelligence: the fifth AI Growth OS Feature, a deterministic domain subsystem that owns the analytics behavior only (ADR-0053). The Social -> Analytics step of the growth chain: it consumes a Social Intelligence output and, through it, the SEO, content, and marketing references (all by reference), plus knowledge by reference, and frames a governed analytics task: an immutable AnalyticsPlan carrying the frozen Agent Engine AgentRequest (prompt, provider steps), plus an analytics-quality EvaluationRequest for the frozen Evaluation Engine. It is deterministic and fail-closed; it never owns business truth, never executes, invokes a provider, selects a model, evaluates, decides, orchestrates, or schedules, and builds no new platform infrastructure.
